# Project Instructions

## Knowledge base

@../kb/index.md

- At the start of every task, read `kb/index.md` and use it as the project's knowledge-base entry point. Read the relevant linked pages before making project changes or answering project-specific questions.
- Keep the knowledge base in sync with lasting project changes. When code, tests, documentation, build configuration, architecture, or behavior changes, update the relevant KB page in the same task.
- When a user requests or clarifies lasting product behavior, record that requirement in the relevant KB page, even if implementation is deferred. Add unresolved details to `kb/open-questions.md` rather than guessing.
- Update `kb/index.md` when KB pages are added, removed, renamed, or their scope changes.
- Keep KB updates focused on durable project knowledge; do not record one-off instructions or routine task details.
